key_insight: High-order discontinuous Galerkin spectral element simulations reproduce reference finite-volume results for a two-dimensional scramjet flow with shock–shock interactions.
engineering_relevance: DGSEM offers an alternative to established second-order finite-volume methods for simulating complex hypersonic flows relevant to scramjet design.
method: Apply high-order DGSEM with element-local polynomial bases.
Compare results with reference finite-volume solvers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with reference finite-volume solvers, supporting code verification, but provides no quantitative error or runtime metrics.
watch_item: Accuracy and efficiency advantages over finite-volume methods remain unquantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Efficient high-order Discontinuous Galerkin simulations of multi-species high-enthalpy flows
